summary: Add a separate managed Reference QA browser workflow and local immutable result, citation and human-review persistence while retaining the legacy analysis and question workspace.
decision_refs: Active user goal: CRIP manages local files, projects, tasks, versions, results, citations and review
Reference analysis remains separate from existing default behavior
Page preview, result reads and human review must not call a model
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested the management-first CRIP framework, retained existing behavior and approved continued implementation of the bounded advanced-model reference workflow.
known_limitations: Reference results currently support accept or reject review but not reviewer-edited answer text.
The fixed 15-question live quality benchmark has not been rerun.
Reference result export and cross-run result comparison remain future work.
